changes: Adds bounded selectors-based nvidia-smi output collection.
Pins and queries the selected GPU UUID from the original NLL admission identity.
Adds stable PID directory inode/UID/starttime checks and bounded cgroup/same-UID command-line identity reads.
Runs the fresh ownership check after existing gates and immediately before create-only D.mkdir.

fresh_selected_gpu_gate.campaign_owner_gate: Fails closed for a wnn-campaign.slice cgroup owner or same-UID command line containing the project path.
fresh_selected_gpu_gate.device_query: Requires one matching UUID/name row and parses current free/total MiB with nonzero total and free<=total.
fresh_selected_gpu_gate.foreign_process_behavior: Records/preserves unrelated owners and performs no signal or termination.
fresh_selected_gpu_gate.per_process_identity: No-follow bounded /proc reads; captures UID and cgroup, reads command line only for same-UID PIDs, and requires PID directory inode/UID/starttime to remain stable across observation.
fresh_selected_gpu_gate.position: Runs after all existing fresh checks and before D.mkdir/output mutation.
fresh_selected_gpu_gate.process_query: Read-only compute-app query capped at 64 KiB per output stream, 15 seconds, and 256 process rows; rejects malformed/duplicate PID or mismatched UUID.
fresh_selected_gpu_gate.source: Pinned GPU identity string in the original NLL ADMISSION.json.

non_blocking_notes.finding: The inherited rendered_body_authority.source_review_scope string still says “exact rendered V1 stdin body remains a root prelaunch gate.” It is a metadata prose label, not an executable gate or body-SHA claim. Root will externally bind this exact V2 body and interpret the inherited string as referring to the V1 base.

At the theoretical 256-row and 32-KiB-per-cgroup-read caps, the generated admission could exceed the result-capture reader’s 1-MB per-file limit. The result remains conditionally compatible; root must enforce the actual admission <=1 MB and capture aggregate <=4 MB before using that reader, or prepare a narrow bounded-reader cap update if actual bytes exceed the bound. This review makes no prediction that the actual receipt will be oversized.

payload_review.comparison: V2 embedded payload literals equal V1 literals; each decoded local bounded code/metadata input matches its exact local bytes, byte count, and SHA-256.

render_binding.root_authority: Exact V2 stdin body/raw transport remains externally bound by root; worker does not read __file__ or claim a worker-computed body SHA-256.

review_limits: PASS_SOURCE_ONLY does not authorize B staging, support admission, submission, result capture, or a checker result.
No GPU state was queried in this review; only the exact gate source and pinned identity were inspected.
The actual V2 support admission and launch receipts/invocation do not yet exist and are not bound in this candidate.

scope.review_kind: independent exact-body source and bounded payload-pin review
